mode.title: What to scrape
mode.description: Reviews: every review of the products below. Product details: rating, feature ratings, pricing, awards, competitors, install base. Category products: the ranked product list of the categories below. Alternatives: competitors and alternatives by company size. Compare: head-to-head comparison pages. Category tree: every category with its slug.

products.title: Products
products.description: For Reviews, Product details and Alternatives. A product slug (hubspot-crm) or any TrustRadius product URL (https://www.trustradius.com/products/hubspot-crm/reviews).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: For Category products. A category slug (crm) or a category URL (https://www.trustradius.com/categories/crm). Run the Category tree mode to see every slug.

comparisons.title: Comparisons
comparisons.description: For Compare products. Two product slugs as 'hubspot-crm-vs-pipedrive' or 'hubspot-crm, pipedrive', or a /compare-products/ URL.

maxItems.title: Max results per input
maxItems.description: Reviews per product, or products per category. Other modes return everything on the page.

reviewsNewerThan.title: Only reviews published on or after
reviewsNewerThan.description: Reviews: stop at the first review older than this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Reviews are listed newest first, so this makes daily or weekly monitoring cheap.

includeReviewDetails.title: Include the full review questionnaire
includeReviewDetails.description: Reviews: also open each review's own page for the answers the list does not show -- feature-by-feature ratings, usability score, return on investment, alternatives the reviewer evaluated, other software used, reviewer's country and roles. One extra page per review.

includePricing.title: Include the pricing page
includePricing.description: Product details: also read the product's pricing page for reviewer price quotes, support channels, deployment types and priced alternatives. One extra page per product.

companySize.title: Company size
companySize.description: Category products: rank the list for this company size.

topRatedOnly.title: Top Rated award winners only
topRatedOnly.description: Category products: only products holding a current TrustRadius Top Rated award.

hasPricingOnly.title: Only products with published pricing
hasPricingOnly.description: Category products: only products that publish pricing on TrustRadius.

freeOptionOnly.title: Only products with a free option
freeOptionOnly.description: Category products: only products with a free plan or free option.

operatingSystem.title: Operating system
operatingSystem.description: Category products: only products that run on this operating system.

deepPagination.title: Go past the first 1,000 products
deepPagination.description: TrustRadius stops paging a category at 1,000 products. When no filter is set, this re-walks the category in its other orderings and slices and merges them without duplicates to reach further.

filterCategoryTree.title: Category tree: only matching categories
filterCategoryTree.description: Category tree: return only categories whose slug or name matches the Categories list above.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel requests
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages are fetched at the same time. Higher is faster; lower is gentler and gets fewer refused pages (those are retried automatically).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies are recommended for reliable results. A page that is refused is retried automatically from a new IP.
